trigger: Before starting a software project task that changes workflow assets from a DeepSeek Harness session
When planning, reviewing, or validating project-governance work from a dsh preset session

native_entry.preset_file: ${DSH_HOME}/.agent-presets/governance/agent.cordis.yml (rendered from agent-presets/governance/agent.cordis.yml.template by the bundle row lib/index.js on boot, or by adapters/dsh/launch.py --install)
native_entry.project_instruction_file: AGENTS.md (auto-injected by dsh as workspace instructions)
native_entry.note: dsh has no plugin marketplace and no slash-command surface. The loading model is a rendered agent preset: cordis.patch.yml inserts exactly one host row (this package's own — DEC-187 forbids touching any other row), whose lib/index.js ensurePreset() renders agent-presets/governance/agent.cordis.yml.template with ABSOLUTE package paths into ${DSH_HOME}/.agent-presets/governance/ — the USER preset root, so the settings page shows it as a custom preset with delete and open-folder. The composition registers the repo skills/ directory plus the adapters/dsh/skill-shims/ command projections as custom skill roots via skill-filesystem.customSkillDirs, so the native skill tool exposes the whole workflow catalog; user gesture /governance loads the governance command shim skill. adapters/dsh/launch.py --install renders the byte-identical composition as the manual/offline path. AGENTS.md is auto-injected into every session whose workspace contains it, and the preset persona carries the Coordinator bootstrap. Single-point diagnostics for this adapter plane: python skills/software-project-governance/infra/verify_workflow.py dsh-doctor (stages S0-S7, four switches, exit codes 0/1/2, per-stage crash isolation degrades a crashed stage to NOT_RUN) — declared here alongside the check-dsh-* gates per design 2.9.4 (FIX-326 item 1 manifest registration).

ask_user_question.evidence: dsh ships a native ask_user_question tool (dsh-tool-ask-user) with options/multi-select support; used for every interaction boundary in the live session that authored this adapter.

sub_agent.evidence: dsh ships native subagent and subagent_fork tools with in-process spawn and fork providers; children inherit the parent preset composition. The live session that authored this adapter ran three parallel subagents through it.

tool_calling.evidence: dsh ships native pwsh, fs read/write/edit, glob, grep, web_search, background jobs, goal, and todo tools; the live session used all of them while authoring this adapter.

browser.evidence: dsh has web_search but no browser automation tool for page-level validation.
browser.degraded_mode: Mark browser validation blocked or run it from another host adapter.

mcp.evidence: The dsh install ships an MCP client package, but server availability depends on host configuration.
mcp.degraded_mode: Use local scripts and record MCP unavailable when no MCP server is configured.

git_hooks.evidence: Workflow installs and validates pre-commit, commit-msg, and post-commit hooks at the repository level, independent of the agent runtime. The hooks' find_spg_home resolves the workflow home under dsh through the skill-root.txt marker both renderers write into ${DSH_HOME}/.agent-presets/governance/ (it names the package root, i.e. <pkg>/skills/software-project-governance; a legacy copied skills tree at the same location is still accepted), so installed project hooks self-upgrade after `git pull` + `launch.py --sync`.

workflow_closure.evidence: dsh has native ask_user_question, sub_agent, tool_calling, and git_hooks; the strongest native profile together with Chrys. Only browser automation and MCP remain host-dependent.

runtime_e2e.evidence: This adapter was authored from a live DeepSeek Harness session whose workspace is the repository itself. The session loaded the editing-cordis-compositions skill through the native skill tool, ran three parallel subagents through the native subagent tool, used ask_user_question/pwsh/fs/web_search, and mount-validated the generated governance preset through agentPresets.standingKeyFor. The dsh version this was verified against, the date it was last verified, the resolution plane and the oracle package versions are NOT restated here: they are recorded once in `adapters/dsh/host-contract.json` (`evidence.dsh_cli_version` / `evidence.verified_on` / `evidence.plane` / `evidence.oracle_packages`) and refreshed only by `dsh-doctor --record-evidence` on a real plane (design 2.4/2.7). A version literal in this file would be a second, unverifiable source of the same fact.

target_cwd_e2e.evidence: Executed from project/e2e-test-project cwd on the local host and returned Test Project status with default-confirm permission mode (same target-cwd fixture every adapter uses).

agent_runtime_e2e.command: dsh session on the governance preset reading .governance/plan-tracker.md from the project cwd
agent_runtime_e2e.evidence: The live dsh session consumed the repository AGENTS.md as auto-injected workspace instructions, loaded governance skills through the native skill tool, and mount-validated the generated preset. E2E_PLATFORM=dsh; E2E_AGENT=Coordinator.
